text: At this time the model does not identify any single change that would automatically turn the decision around. However, you can still strengthen your overall credit profile, which improves the chances of future approval. Start by paying down existing balances so that you use a smaller portion of each credit limit. If you have credit cards or loans, aim to keep utilization below 30 percent. Consider adding a secured credit card or a small, on‑time installment loan to build positive payment history. Regularly check your credit reports for errors and dispute any inaccuracies. Set up automatic payments or reminders to ensure every bill is paid on time. Over several months of consistent, responsible behavior, your risk rating is likely to improve.
